headline: Ukraine's Budget Loses Up to UAH 36.4 Billion Due to Illegal Cigarette Market
summary: According to Kantar estimates, the share of illegal cigarettes in Ukraine has reached 21.6%. Annual budget losses amount to UAH 36.4 billion.
why: Illegal tobacco trade erodes excise and VAT revenue and gives untaxed products a price advantage over legal producers. This affects public finances and licensed tobacco companies.
